slides.body: Saturn's mahadasha (major planetary period) runs 19 years in the Vimshottari system, second only to Venus at 20. It is a long arc, not a quick sprint.
Saturn signifies discipline, structure, time and responsibility. Think of it as the technical-debt phase: the work nobody applauds, that everything else rests on.

points: Be consistent when results are slow
Respect limits of time and energy

slides.body: Saturn rewards patience. Foundations built in this season tend to be the ones that last, especially when Saturn is well placed and well supported.
Within the mahadasha, the antardasha (sub-period) is your current sprint. Ask: which foundation does this sub-period let me strengthen?
Saturn's sign, house, strength and your wider chart decide how this feels. Use it as a planning lens, never as a verdict.
